description: Record an application the user already has in .antideploy.json for this folder, so deploys and the other tools act on it. Take the id from `list_applications`. Only when the user said which one; never guess, because deploying a project over another application replaces what is live there.

directory.description: The project folder. Defaults to this server's working directory.

name: link_application
title: Use an existing application for this folder
